aciklama: Visually labelled by the assistant (Claude) from the header crops and contact sheets on 2026-10-23, to be checked by Talha. Every field as the page PRINTS it, not as SymbTr's file name gives it; null = not printed.
kurallar: values as printed (case and accents; where an accent could not be told at this resolution, the plain letter)
label words (Usulu:, Muzik:, Beste:, Soz:) and life dates such as (1890-1942) are left out
eser_adi: the work's printed name: a lyric title when one is printed (brackets or quotes dropped), otherwise the heading line; an instrumental work's name is its heading, e.g. RAST PESREV
makam and form: from the heading line; form is the printed form word(s) after the makam
kaynak: the publisher or archive line(s), joined with a space; catalogue numbers (TSM Repertuar No, archive numbers) are left out
Soz ve Muzik: X / Gufte ve Beste: X gives X as both bestekar and gufte
okunaksiz: fields printed but not readable with confidence; they are not scored
